templates.description: A new website, with Own It Now or Own It Over Time and an optional care plan.
templates.title: A new website for {{client.company}}
templates.markdown:
# Overview

Hi {{client.first_name}}, thanks for walking us through where {{client.company}} is today. Here's what we heard: [two or three sentences on their current site and what's not working, in their words].

This proposal covers a new website built to [main outcome, e.g. turn more visitors into calls], plus the options for owning and caring for it.

# Goals

- [Goal 1, e.g. more booked calls from the website]
- [Goal 2, e.g. a site the team can update without help]
- [Goal 3, e.g. show up in local and AI search]

# What's included

- Discovery call and site plan (pages, content and calls to action)
- Custom design for desktop, tablet and phone
- Build of up to [number] pages: [list pages]
- On-page SEO basics: titles, descriptions, headings, image alt text, sitemap
- Speed, security and accessibility checks before launch
- Forms connected to [email or CRM]
- Launch, redirects from old pages, and 30 days of fixes after launch
- A short training video on editing your site

Not included: [e.g. copywriting beyond [number] pages, photography, paid ads]. We're happy to quote these separately.

# Timeline and what we need from you

- **Discovery and plan** · Weeks 1–2 · We need: Logins, brand files, goals
- **Design** · Weeks 3–4 · We need: Feedback within 3 business days
- **Build and content** · Weeks 5–7 · We need: Final text and photos
- **Review and launch** · Week 8 · We need: Final sign-off

The timeline starts once the proposal is signed and the kickoff payment is received.

# Why {{workspace.name}}

[Two or three sentences on why you're the right fit for this client.]

[Case study: client, the problem, what you did, the result with a number.]

# Investment

(pricing_table)

Own It Now is paid as a one-time project fee. Own It Over Time is a smaller kickoff payment followed by monthly payments; the site becomes yours after the final payment (see Terms).

[If the client chooses Own It Over Time, add the kickoff as a one-time Custom line with its amount, then delete this note.]

# Next steps

1. Choose your options above and sign below.
2. We'll send the kickoff invoice and any monthly setup.
3. We'll book your discovery call within two business days.

templates.name: Social media management
templates.description: A monthly social media plan: content, posting, replies and reporting.
templates.title: A social media plan for {{client.company}}
templates.markdown:
# Overview

Hi {{client.first_name}}, [two or three sentences on where {{client.company}}'s social media is today and what they want from it, in their words].

This proposal covers monthly social media management on [Facebook and Instagram]: we plan, create and post the content, look after comments and messages, and report on what's working.

# Goals

- Post consistently, so {{client.company}} stays visible to the people who already follow you
- Grow a local audience that turns into [calls, bookings, visits or sales]
- Answer comments and messages quickly, so no customer question goes unanswered

# What's included every month

- A monthly content calendar, sent for your approval before anything is posted
- Designed graphics, captions and hashtags for every post
- Scheduling and posting at the times your audience is most active
- Replies to comments and messages on business days
- A monthly report: reach, engagement and follower growth, with what we'll try next

Not included unless added: paid ads and ad spend, video shoots, influencer outreach, and platforms not listed above.

# Choosing a plan

The plans differ by how often we post. [One sentence recommending a plan for this client and why.]

- Starter: 8 posts a month, about 2 a week
- Growth: 12 posts a month, about 3 a week
- Pro: 18 posts a month, about 4–5 a week
- Premium: 24 posts a month, close to daily

Add-ons, added to any plan: LinkedIn [$200] a month, each additional platform [$200] a month, and short-form video (Reels) [$75–150] each.

# What to expect

Social media builds over time. Most accounts see steadier engagement after [two to three months] of consistent posting. Platforms change how they show posts, so we can't promise a number of followers or likes; we'll show you what's changing every month.

# What we need from you

- Admin access to your [Facebook and Instagram] accounts
- Your logo, brand colors and any photos you'd like us to use
- Approval of each month's calendar within [3] business days. We only post what you've approved, so a late approval moves that month's posts later.

# Why {{workspace.name}}

[Case study: a business like theirs, where they started, and a result with a number.]

# Investment

(pricing_table)

Billed monthly. Plans have a [3]-month minimum, then continue month to month until either of us cancels with 30 days' notice.

# Next steps

1. Choose a plan and sign below.
2. You'll get a secure link to set up monthly billing.
3. We'll book a kickoff call, get access to your accounts, and send your first content calendar.

clauses.heading: Scope of work
clauses.body: We'll deliver the work described in this proposal. Anything not listed is out of scope. If you'd like to change the scope, we'll agree the change and any cost in writing before we start it.

clauses.heading: Your responsibilities
clauses.body: You'll give us the content, access and feedback we need on time. If something we need is late, the timeline moves by the same amount.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.body: One-time fees are invoiced and due within 14 days. Recurring fees are billed monthly in advance. If a payment is more than 15 days late, we may pause work until it's paid.

clauses.heading: Timeline and delays
clauses.body: Dates in this proposal are estimates. Neither of us is responsible for delays caused by things outside our reasonable control.

clauses.heading: Ownership
clauses.body: Once you've paid in full, you own the finished work we create for you. We keep the right to use our general tools, methods and know-how, and we may show the work in our portfolio unless you ask us not to.

clauses.heading: Third-party services
clauses.body: Hosting, domains, plugins and other services from other companies have their own terms and fees. We're not responsible for their outages or changes.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.body: We'll each keep the other's private business information private, and use it only for this work.

clauses.heading: Warranty and liability
clauses.body: We'll fix defects in our work that you report within 30 days of delivery, at no charge. Apart from that, our total liability under this agreement is limited to the fees you paid us in the 3 months before the claim.

clauses.heading: Term and cancellation
clauses.body: Monthly services continue month to month until either of us cancels with 30 days' written notice. Fees already paid aren't refunded.

clauses.heading: Governing law
clauses.body: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of {{workspace.state}}.

clauses.heading: Entire agreement
clauses.body: This signed proposal is the whole agreement between us about this work and replaces earlier discussions.
